name: home-assistant
description: General-purpose Home Assistant device control, scene activation, and status monitoring via REST API

tools.name: ha_control
tools.description: Control any Home Assistant device: turn on/off, toggle, lock/unlock, set brightness, set temperature.

entity_id.description: HA entity ID (e.g. light.office_desk, lock.front_door, switch.garage)

temperature.description: For climate: target temperature in °F. Optional.

tools.name: ha_status
tools.description: Get a summary of the home: lights on/off count, locks locked/unlocked, climate readings.

domain.description: Filter by domain: light, switch, lock, sensor, climate, etc. Omit for full summary.

tools.name: ha_state
tools.description: Get the current state and attributes of a specific entity.

tools.name: ha_scene
tools.description: Activate a Home Assistant scene (e.g. good_night, movie_time, morning).

scene.description: Scene name or entity_id (with or without scene. prefix)

automation_id.description: Automation entity_id (with or without automation. prefix)

tools.name: ha_list
tools.description: List entities filtered by domain (light, lock, sensor, climate, switch, etc.).

domain.description: Entity domain to list (light, lock, sensor, climate, switch, cover, fan, etc.)
